token_saving_decisions: Exact provider token usage was unavailable; zero values are not measured usage.
Kept all drag positions and failed-image state local to the canvas instead of persisting presentation changes as portfolio topology.
Used only explicit app-icon metadata and project preview origins; labels and names were never used to infer brands or relationships.
Validated focused model facts, the 128-test frontend suite, a production build, and independent review without a global topology regeneration.
